user.title: Select Power NI Keypad+ Meter
user.description: Choose a discovered meter or select manual entry.

manual.title: Enter Meter Bluetooth MAC Address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Power NI Freedom Unit (for example, AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.already_configured: This Power NI meter is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported Power NI meter.

init.title: Power NI Keypad+ Options
init.description: Adjust how often Home Assistant polls your Freedom Unit (1 to 1440 minutes, default 15) and optionally pin it to the bonded Bluetooth proxy or adapter.

pairing_required.title: Bluetooth pairing required for {name}
pairing_required.description:
Home Assistant could not authenticate with **{name}** (`{address}`) via **{proxy}**.

Power NI Freedom Units require a one-time 6-digit PIN bond on the Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy connecting to them. Pair the meter with that adapter/proxy (or pin the already-bonded proxy under **Configure**). If the meter ignores pairing, enter `*159268#` (`B#######` units) or `*0#` (`PNI#####` units) on the keypad to reset its Bluetooth radio.
